title: Juice bottling (rehearsal)
about: Scripted answers made from the hand-written stations of spec/examples/bottling-line.factory.json, encoded by the Builder's own schemas. No model is asked; the owner's comments are not read.

plan.title: Filling
plan.does: Fills each empty bottle with juice through a dosing nozzle
steps: nozzle down, valve open, fill 6 s, valve closed, nozzle up

plan.title: Capping
plan.does: Screws a cap onto each filled bottle

plan.title: Inspection
plan.does: Checks each capped bottle with a camera and pushes rejects onto a lane

vision.why: camera and light over the belt

plan.title: Case packing
plan.does: Packs the good bottles into cases
